answer: Build a trellis of peer endorsements: a new agent may act only after endorsements from several established, non-kin agents, and each endorsement's weight melts like a glacier, forcing continuous re-earning rather than a one-time boost. Endorsers caught backing fakes lose their own endorsement power, so backing a Sybil costs real reputation. To find fakes cheaply, deploy velvet probes: friendly agents that invite newcomers into risky trades and watch for coordinated, identical behavior, exposing duplicated minds at scale without expensive audits.
